content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Bhopal Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 21-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bhopal (AIIMS Bhopal) for various project-based research and technical positions under an ICMR-funded project.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in AIIMS Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts include Project Research Scientist-I (Medical), Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical), Project Technical Support-I, and Project Technical Support-II.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies available across various project research and technical support positions in the Department of Urology at AIIMS Bhopal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of completed applications via email is 21-10-2026. Candidates must ensure they submit their applications on or before this date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their filled application form along with self-attested documents to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for AIIMS Bhopal Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on qualifications and experience, followed directly by an interview. There is no written test conducted for these posts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the date of the interview?
faq.answer: The date of the interview for all posts is scheduled for 23-10-2026. Shortlisted candidates are required to attend with original documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range for these positions?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly salary ranges from Rs. 21,600 to Rs. 80,400 depending on the specific post and the qualifications required for it.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee is specified in the official notification for applying to any of the advertised posts at AIIMS Bhopal.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and website details?
faq.answer: You can check the official AIIMS Bhopal website at www.aiimsbhopal.edu.in or refer to the direct notification links provided in the important links section of this article.
